provenance.selection: mAL_m types with GABA consensus transmitter; pC1_ types with fruDsx coexpress_high; retain nodes participating in actual direct mAL-to-pC1 edges. Broader P1-related Fru+/Dsx+ pC1 cohort, not exact genetic driver line reconstruction.
provenance.edgeMeaning: Raw synapse-count weights; sign is a model assumption supported by GABA annotation and published mAL inhibition, not a measured signed synapse table.
provenance.geometry: Real SWC points and soma coordinates, 8nm voxel units

assumptions: Reduced feedforward rate model, not whole-brain or fruitless gene simulation.
Only direct selected mAL-to-pC1 edges modeled. Upstream sensory circuits and other inputs omitted.
Sensory drives male/female 0.75/1; inhibitory cue drives male/female 1/0.2 are chosen schematic values, not fitted or measured.
Anatomical edge weights divided by mean total incoming synapse count across selected pC1 nodes.
Rate time constant 0.3 seconds, fixed courtship threshold 0.35, perturbation scales inhibitory output to 10%.
Procedural locomotion driven by fixed P1-related mean output decoder. Parallel target channels are independent simplified sensory presentations, not two brains.
Restoration and clamp are software dependency controls, not biological validation.
